```{r echo = T, results = 'hide', message=FALSE}
source('functions_adwm.R')
```

## Read in data
```{r}
exp3_dt_raw <- read_dt('./exp3_data')
exp3_dt_raw <- exp3_dt_raw[presentation_time != 20]
```

## Density plot
```{r}
dplot <- ggplot(exp3_dt_raw, 
                aes(x=error_angle, 
                    group=as.factor(presentation_time),
                    color=as.factor(presentation_time))) +
  geom_density(size=1.5) +
  scale_colour_grey(start = 0.75, end = 0., 
                    name='Presentation\ntime (ms)') +
  scale_x_continuous(name='Error Angle (rad)', 
                     limits=c(-pi, pi),
                     breaks=c(-pi, 0, pi),
                     labels=c(expression(-pi), 0, expression(pi))) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.6, 0.7))

dplot
#ggsave('exp3_dplot.png', dplot, dpi=600, width=4, height=3)
```

## Effect of Cue
```{r}
#exp3_summary_boot_dt <- bootstrap_adwm(exp3_dt_raw, 
#                                       c('cue'), 
#                                       n_iter = 100)
#save(exp3_summary_boot_dt, file="exp3_summary_boot_dt.RData")

load("./exp3_summary_boot_dt.RData")
```

### Encoding curves
```{r}
color_indices <- c(1,4)
plot_colours <- brewer.pal(max(color_indices), 'RdBu')[color_indices]

exp3_summary_boot_dt$summary_dt <- exp3_summary_boot_dt$summary_dt[, cue := factor(cue, levels=c('FAST', 'SLOW'))]
exp3_encoding_plot <- plot_encoding_rc(exp3_summary_boot_dt$summary_dt, 
                 c('cue'), 
                 color_indices=c(1,4), exp3_summary_boot_dt$pars_dt)

exp3_encoding_plot <- exp3_encoding_plot +
  scale_colour_manual(values=plot_colours, 
                      labels = c('Short', 'Long'),
                      name='Cued presentation time')

exp3_encoding_plot
#ggsave('exp2a_encoding_curves.png', dpi=500, width=5, height=3)
```

### Parameter plots
```{r}
parplot_dt <- exp3_summary_boot_dt$pars_dt
parplot_dt <- parplot_dt[, cue := factor(cue, levels=c('FAST', 'SLOW'))]
exp3_parplot <- plot_parameter_summary(parplot_dt, 
                                        c('cue'),
                       color_indices=c(1, 4))

x_axis <- ggdraw() +
  draw_label(expression(paste('Cued presentation time')))

exp3_parplot <- exp3_parplot &
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c('Short', 'Long'))

exp3_parplot <- exp3_parplot / x_axis +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2), height=c(1, 0.1))

exp3_parplot
#ggsave('exp2a_parplot.png', dpi=500, width=6, height=3)
```

```{r}
# create full plot with both encoding curve and par. estimates
exp3_fullplot <- exp3_encoding_plot / exp3_parplot
ggsave('exp3_fullplot.png', width=5, height=6, dpi=500)
ggsave('exp3_fullplot.tiff', 
       plot = exp3_fullplot,
       width=5, height=6, dpi=500)

```

# Get stats
```{r}
# Encoding speed
exp3_summary_boot_dt$stats_dt[, median(coefficient_rate)]
exp3_summary_boot_dt$stats_dt[, median(t_value_rate)]
exp3_summary_boot_dt$stats_dt[, median(p_value_rate)]
exp3_summary_boot_dt$stats_dt[, median(BF10_rate)]
exp3_summary_boot_dt$stats_dt[, median(dBIC_rate)]

# One-sided Bayes Factor described in Morey & Wagenmakers (2014)
exp3_summary_boot_dt$stats_dt[, median(p_value_rate) * median(BF10_rate)]
```

```{r}

exp3_summary_boot_dt$stats_dt[, median(coefficient_capacity)]

exp3_summary_boot_dt$stats_dt[, median(p_value_capacity)]
exp3_summary_boot_dt$stats_dt[, median(BF10_capacity)]
exp3_summary_boot_dt$stats_dt[, median(dBIC_capacity)]
```
